title: FloorPriceStrategyInput
description: Array of inventory units to analyze for optimal floor price.

inventory_unit.description: Identifier for the ad inventory unit (e.g., 'Leaderboard_ATF', 'Mobile_Banner').

avg_cpm.description: Current average CPM in USD over the measurement window.

fill_rate_percentage.description: Observed fill rate as a percentage (0–100).

bid_density_peak_range.description: Dollar range representing the peak bid density band (e.g., '$0.80-$1.20').
